title: Crossfunctional Firebreaks & Actions - Sept 2026
summary: Lightweight spreadsheet to track cross-functional "firebreak" requests, one-off interventions, and short-lived capacity or config changes that require coordination across eng, product, and SRE. Meant for quick triage, owner assignment, and temporary mitigations while a longer plan is worked out.
content:
Columns: ID | Date Raised | Raised By | Owner | Primary Team | Severity | Short Description | Services/Routes Impacted | Quick Mitigation | ETA for Follow-up | Current Status | Notes | Linked Tickets

FBRK-001 | 2026-09-06 | Marco Ruiz | Emily Chen | serving-runtime | Sev-2 | Sudden tokenization regression for 4096-sec requests after kernel patch | hosted-api / text-generation v2 | Roll back kernel patch on pool-3, enable legacy allocator | 2026-09-08 | in_progress | rollback scheduled 09/07 02:00 UTC; monitoring through 09/09 | JIRA:SRV-2331; PR:runtime#4123

FBRK-002 | 2026-09-07 | Jonah Brooks | Sofia Alvarez | observability | Sev-3 | Alert flapping on per-route latency dashboard after sampling change | console-and-rollouts / metrics | Temporarily revert sampling to 1% for routes >100rps; suppress noise alerts | 2026-09-09 | assigned | needs SLI owner for longer-term sampling config; noted for next ops retro | JIRA:OBS-890

FBRK-003 | 2026-09-07 | Aisha Patel | Marco Ruiz | private-deployments | Sev-2 | Customer A reported missing audit logs after onboarding KMS rotation | private-control-plane | Re-enable verbose audit log mode; request fresh syslog export | 2026-09-08 | blocked | waiting on customer's infra team to provide access window; escalation to AE done | CONFLUENCE:customer-A-onboarding; JIRA:SEC-1213
